commit_message: Finish ADR 0122 spatial audio tests and voice lifecycle
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0122 spatial audio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0122 first-release spatial audio on current main. Reuses the existing engine-owned spatial evaluator and managed voice backend, adds deterministic listener priority and ECS synchronization, generation-checked Project Rust spatial playback, Audio Emitter/Listener authoring, Scene View spatial gizmos, transient Play/Stop/Restart audition, and audition/runtime parity tests. Existing 2D PlaySoundEffect remains compatible and backend voice identity stays process-local.

## Validation

Run affected Windows Validation for engine, engine-editor, engine-platform, and engine-scripting, plus task-specific Editor Visual Validation for the Spatial Audio Inspector and Scene View.
